title: WorldCore: Troubleshooting
summary: Diagnose common WorldCore failures by shrinking the loop and testing one fix.

blocks.title: Common Failure
blocks.body: If a hazard feels invisible, check whether WorldCore is loaded, whether this route has region data, and whether the current biome or structure matches the hazard rules.

blocks.title: Reset The Loop
blocks.body: If hazards feel invisible, verify the region context, check current conditions, compare the biome or structure, and look for the preparation clue you skipped.

blocks.title: One Fix At A Time
blocks.body: Change one variable, run a smaller test, and compare the result. Fixing three things at once can hide the part that actually mattered.

blocks.title: Retest Cleanly
blocks.body: Change one variable, test on a smaller route, and keep the fix only if the failure becomes easier to explain.
